answer: To invalidate the Sybil fable, the protocol enforces quadratic staking and slashing penalties tied to cluster density. This mechanism creates a capital tundra, forcing marginal attack costs to scale super-linearly relative to any potential extracted value from malicious consensus shifts. Consequently, the network achieves a security oasis where negative expected utility sustains a robust Nash equilibrium through zero-knowledge verifiable delay primitives and high-liquidity sink commitments.
